methodProvenance.confidenceFieldIsNotLoadBearing: Admission was decided structurally and from a source index of what the DS actually stamps, not from the scout grade. The double-census adjudication measured scout self-confidence at Cohen kappa 0.179 (REC-4).
methodProvenance.partAnchoringRule: R-8, decided from source: a part is admitted only where the DS stamps data-part with that name, or a DS component-identity class pair matches. Scout prose is corroboration, not authority.

unanchoredPartClaims.reason: Not a part name. The scout recorded a placeholder or a raw class token here, not a DS-stamped part identity; nothing addressable follows from it under RULING R-8.

partsStampedInSourceNotClaimedByScout.status: MEASURED, NOT ADMITTED. The DS stamps these data-part names inside this family owner tree but no scout claimed them. Admission waits on the part-ownership ruling (open method axis 4), because a stamp inside the owner tree may belong to a nested family.

sourceEvidence.engineDivergence: classic = Ant Menu wrapper (src/ui/primitives/navigation/Menu/engines/classic/index.tsx:45); no data-part, no --ds-* reads. modern owns all eleven parts and the full ARIA menu contract. rustic owns the same part names but a different state set: it adds data-focused (:196) and data-key (:201) and uses aria-haspopup (:199), none of which modern stamps; it omits data-level, data-selected-descendant, data-disclosure-panel, data-mode, data-collapsed and data-has-selection. rustic also hardcodes four transitions ('all 0.2s ease' :216, 'transform 0.2s ease' :229, 'height 0.2s ease' :252, 'all 0.2s ease' :302). A second modern-facing paint layer exists outside the engine skin: src/foundation/tokens/css/presentation/components/skin/menu-compounds.css.

variableReadCensus.attribution: UNATTRIBUTED RAW EVIDENCE. Measured reads and declarations, not mapped to any controlId. themeControls stays UNKNOWN until the mapping wave; this block must not be read as a control edge.

inertFallbackChains.definition: A read whose OUTER rung already carries a :root default in a shipped stylesheet. The inner fallback rungs can never be consulted, so the control edge exists syntactically but is not causal. The modern skin states this rule in its own words at src/foundation/tokens/css/runtime/engines/modern/skin/overlay-modal.css:164-178.
